cases.title: Initiate drag event on product item
cases.description: Precondition: The product list is rendered with draggable product items containing data-testid attributes such as 'product-item-1', 'product-title-1', and 'product-price-1'. Steps: Drag the product item 'product-item-1'. Expected Behavior: The system initiates a drag event capturing the product's title and price for transfer.

cases.title: Drag and drop product into drop area to update cart
cases.description: Precondition: Product items and the designated drop area (id='div1', data-testid='drop-area') are present. Steps: Drag and drop a product item into the drop area. Expected Behavior: The cart display automatically updates with the product title appearing in .box2, the unit price in .box3, and the quantity in .box1.

cases.title: Calculate and display total price in allMoney element
cases.description: Precondition: Products have been added to the cart. Steps: System calculates the total price by summing the prices of all products in the cart. Expected Behavior: The total is formatted to two decimal places with the appropriate currency symbol (e.g., '$80.00') and displayed in the <div id='allMoney'> element.

opinions.feedback: All high-level cases are fully grounded in the requirements, possess clear preconditions and expected behaviors, are distinct, and present no blockers.
All test cases are fully grounded in their respective requirements, with clear preconditions, actionable steps, and verifiable expected behaviors.

analysis.analysis: Findings for e2edev_bench_01-R-1: Precondition: The product list is rendered with draggable product items containing data-testid attributes like 'product-item-1', 'product-title-1', and 'product-price-1'. Action: User drags the product item 'product-item-1'. Expected behavior: System initiates a drag event capturing the product's title and price for transfer. Findings for e2edev_bench_01-R-3: Precondition: Product items are available and the drop area 'div1' (data-testid='drop-area') is present. Action: User drags and drops product items into the drop area. Expected behavior: Cart display automatically updates with the product title in .box2, unit price in .box3, and quantity in .box1, supporting both different and repeated products. Findings for e2edev_bench_01-R-5: Precondition: Products are added to the cart resulting in a non-empty cart total. Action: System calculates the total price by summing the prices of all products in the cart. Expected behavior: Total is formatted to two decimal places with the appropriate currency symbol (e.g., '$80.00') and displayed in the <div id='allMoney'> element.
